title: Connected Phrases and Meaning
topic: 辅音接元音、弱读与短语辨义
instructions: 这是原创基础听辨练习，不是官方雅思考试。它只核对听辨选项，不能从文字答案判断或评分你的发音。先隐藏原文，听每题的两遍口播再选择；听到 Choose your answer now（现在选择答案）后可主动暂停，选好再继续。提交后看解析并重听，错题隔天闭卷再做。 英语词与词之间常没有停顿，前词末辅音会接向后词开头元音，例如 pick it up；a、of、can 等词也常弱读。按完整短语和句意选择，不能假设每个词之间都有空白。选项有英文和中文，不使用需要额外语境才能区分的同音短语。
transcript:
Listen and choose. Each item is repeated. You can pause after each item.

Number one. Listen carefully.
Please pick it up.
Again.
Please pick it up.
Choose your answer now. Take your time before the next item.

Number two. Listen carefully.
Turn it off, please.
Again.
Turn it off, please.
Choose your answer now. Take your time before the next item.

Number three. Listen carefully.
She gets up at eight.
Again.
She gets up at eight.
Choose your answer now. Take your time before the next item.

Number four. Listen carefully.
Put it on the desk.
Again.
Put it on the desk.
Choose your answer now. Take your time before the next item.

Number five. Listen carefully.
I need a cup of tea.
Again.
I need a cup of tea.
Choose your answer now. Take your time before the next item.

Number six. Listen carefully.
Please take a seat.
Again.
Please take a seat.
Choose your answer now. Take your time before the next item.

Number seven. Listen carefully.
Can I have it?
Again.
Can I have it?
Choose your answer now. Take your time before the next item.

Number eight. Listen carefully.
We have a lot of time.
Again.
We have a lot of time.
Choose your answer now. Take your time before the next item.

This is the end of the listening practice.

questions.prompt: 第 1 题：听完整短句，选出听到的短语及其意思。
options: A. pick it up — 把它拿起来
B. put it down — 把它放下
answers: A. pick it up — 把它拿起来
questions.explanation: 听到 pick it up，意思是“把它拿起来”。pick 的 /k/ 接向 it，it 的 /t/ 又接向 up，不能按书面空格寻找停顿。

questions.prompt: 第 2 题：听完整短句，选出听到的短语及其意思。
options: A. turn it on — 把它打开
B. turn it off — 把它关掉
answers: B. turn it off — 把它关掉
questions.explanation: 录音中的完整短语是 turn it off，“把它关掉”。it 与 off 可接在一起，末尾的 off 与 on 区别明确。

questions.prompt: 第 3 题：听完整短句，选出听到的短语及其意思。
options: A. gets up at eight — 八点起床
B. goes out at eight — 八点出门
answers: A. gets up at eight — 八点起床
questions.explanation: 听到 gets up at eight，“八点起床”。gets 的末辅音接向 up，up 又可接向 at；口播没有说 goes out。

questions.prompt: 第 4 题：听完整短句，选出听到的短语及其意思。
options: A. put it by the door — 把它放在门边
B. put it on the desk — 把它放在书桌上
answers: B. put it on the desk — 把它放在书桌上
questions.explanation: 听到 put it on the desk。put、it、on 之间可连起来，地点明确是 the desk（书桌），不是 the door（门）。

questions.prompt: 第 5 题：听完整短句，选出听到的短语及其意思。
options: A. a cup of tea — 一杯茶
B. a glass of milk — 一杯牛奶
answers: A. a cup of tea — 一杯茶
questions.explanation: 听到 a cup of tea。a 常弱读为 /ə/，of 常弱读为 /əv/；但 cup 和 tea 仍给出“一杯茶”的明确意思。
questions.evidence: I need a cup of tea.

questions.prompt: 第 6 题：听完整短句，选出听到的短语及其意思。
options: A. take a walk — 散步
B. take a seat — 坐下
answers: B. take a seat — 坐下
questions.explanation: 听到 take a seat，是“坐下”的礼貌说法。take 的末辅音可接向弱读的 a，目标词是 seat，不是 walk。

questions.prompt: 第 7 题：听完整短句，选出听到的短语及其意思。
options: A. Can I give it? — 我可以把它给出去吗
B. Can I have it? — 我可以要它吗
answers: B. Can I have it? — 我可以要它吗
questions.explanation: 听到 Can I have it?，意思是“我可以要它吗”。can 与 I、have 与 it 可连起来；have 与 give 是不同的词。

questions.prompt: 第 8 题：听完整短句，选出听到的短语及其意思。
options: A. a lot of time — 很多时间
B. a little time — 一点时间
answers: A. a lot of time — 很多时间
questions.explanation: 听到 a lot of time，“很多时间”。lot 的末辅音可接向弱读的 of；录音说的是 lot，不是 little。
questions.evidence: We have a lot of time.
